name: io.github.Servosity/prtg-mcp
title: PRTG Network Monitor MCP
description: Every PRTG API v2 endpoint, plus a fleet view across every client's PRTG core: alarms, status

environmentVariables.name: PRTG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for your PRTG core (Account Settings > My Account > API Keys).

environmentVariables.name: PRTG_SERVER
environmentVariables.description: Your PRTG core's host and API v2 port, for example prtg.example.com:1616.

environmentVariables.name: PRTG_FLEET_KEYS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. name=key pairs (comma-separated) for cores registered with core add; used by the fleet tools.

environmentVariables.name: PRTG_CORE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Name of a registered core to point every single-core tool at.

environmentVariables.name: PRTG_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Full API v2 base URL; overrides PRTG_SERVER when set.

environmentVariables.name: PRTG_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to true only for a PRTG core with a self-signed certificate.

environmentVariables.name: PRTG_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to your PRTG core.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Binds the MCP server to one saved client profile.

environmentVariables.name: PRTG_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call.

environmentVariables.name: PRTG_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses.

environmentVariables.name: PRTG_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.
